product_one_liner.value: voize is a voice-documentation app for long-term-care and skilled-nursing facilities that converts caregivers’ spoken notes into structured EHR entries.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes voize as a voice-documentation app for long-term-care and skilled-nursing facilities; caregivers speak into a phone and the AI turns speech into structured EHR entries. Source: https://www.voize.ai/us.

pricing_page.notes: The company has a public pricing page describing its licensing basis, so the answer is true even though the cited text does not state a price. Source: https://www.voize.ai/de/preise.

eng_blog.notes: The technical blog describes the voize tech team sharing how it builds its product. public_docs.notes: The public help center has multiple collections, including 23 hospital articles and 75 stationary-care articles, meeting the threshold for public product documentation. Source: https://help.voize.de/de/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Senior ML Engineer—Speech posting seeks a machine-learning engineer experienced in speech recognition and invites applications. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/voize/31a2c1ca-0655-458c-a281-759c515ee9e8.

model_provider.value: Claude through voize’s inference service; voize also says it uses open and on-device models where appropriate.
